text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — SRE alerted that a monthly archive export in staging was uploaded without SSE-KMS. Likely operator mistake, but putting this here to coordinate triage.

omar: link to object?

omar: can you paste the bucket+key (or just the inventory row)?

elaine: s3://redwood-staging-archive/2026-03/export-2026-03-18.tar.gz — S3 Inventory shows SSE: NONE for that object.

mike: yikes. staging but we should treat as if prod if it touches PII-ish exports.

 tara: steps to triage? do we know if the backup agent IAM role could have written with SSE-C accidentally?

elaine: looks like backup-agent (svc-backup@redwood) did the upload. I pulled CloudTrail event:

cloudtrail snippet:
```
{"eventName":"PutObject","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/backup-agent"},"requestParameters":{"bucketName":"redwood-staging-archive","key":"2026-03/export-2026-03-18.tar.gz","sseAlgorithm":null}}
```

omar: ok so agent didn't specify SSE. Root cause might be role change that removed default-encryption-enforcement or lifecycle hook.

mike: immediate action: block public access (already done), snapshot the object as-is (make a copy) for forensic, then reupload/encrypt a copy with KMS and update inventory. Also create incident ticket.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0123 created by elaine — severity: medium — owner: sec-eng.

elaine: I'm doing the copy now: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging-archive/2026-03/export-2026-03-18.tar.gz s3://redwood-secure-archive/forensics/export-2026-03-18.tar.gz --metadata-directive COPY`

omar: for the encrypted replacement, do `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging-archive/... s3://redwood-staging-archive/2026-03/export-2026-03-18.tar.gz.encrypted --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111111111111:key/abcd-1234-rotating` and then run `aws s3 rm` on the original if copy verified.

tara: before deletion, capture hashes and store in ticket. We need chain-of-custody for compliance.

mike: longer term: two policy gaps here — default-bucket-encryption enforcement and overly broad IAM for backup-agent. I can propose policy changes.

elaine: backup-agent role currently has `s3:PutObject` on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-*-archive/* plus `kms:Encrypt`/`kms:Decrypt` on `*`. We should tighten KMS grants to the specific key ARNs and add condition `StringEquals: {"kms:EncryptionContext:Purpose":"backup"}`.

omar: +1. Also add bucket policy to reject unencrypted uploads: example bucket policy snippet we can add: 

```
{
  "Sid": "DenyUnEncryptedObjectUploads",
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Principal": "*",
  "Action": "s3:PutObject",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-staging-archive/*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringNotEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"}
  }
}
```

tara: careful: that blocks retro tools that use SSE-C. We only support SSE-KMS in prod now, so fine to enforce in prod and staging. For on-prem restore flows we need an exception window.

mike: alternative: enforce via org SCP/guardrails for all archive buckets and run a daily query to detect exceptions. I can add an Athena query that checks inventory for SSE != 'aws:kms'.

elaine: audit logging: add CloudTrail Insights rule to alert on PutObject where `sseAlgorithm` is null for buckets matching `*-archive` and send to #security-alerts.

omar: Regarding KMS: we should NOT keep `kms:*` on `*` for backup-agent. Replace with minimal actions: `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey`, `kms:ReEncryptFrom`, `kms:ReEncryptTo` but scoped to the specific CMKs used for archives. And require `kms:ViaService`: `s3.amazonaws.com` if possible.

mike: for cross-account restore workflows (partners), use ephemeral grants rather than permanent key policy adds. Use `CreateGrant` + store grantToken for the restore session and `RetireGrant` after. That avoids expanding the key policy.

tara: question — if we rotate the CMK, will existing objects encrypted with the old key become inaccessible? We must ensure re-encryption process or use AWS re-encrypt on copy.

omar: KMS CMK rotation is safe for decrypt if you rotate via AWS-managed rotation on the same key (AWS rotates the key material). If you replace the key entirely (new key ARN) then you must re-encrypt objects. Plan: avoid key replacement unless necessary; prefer automatic rotation or re-encrypt via batch job.

elaine: action items so far: 1) forensic copy done (elaine) 2) produce encrypted replacement copy (omar) 3) capture hashes & ticket (tara) 4) tighten backup-agent IAM + KMS scoping (mike) 5) add bucket deny-unencrypted policy / org guardrail (mike) 6) alerting rule for null-SSE PutObject (mike)

mike: I'll open PR with IAM delta and bucket policy. ETA EOD. I'll include a migration plan for objects that predate policy.

oncall-bot: sec-eng-bot assigned INC-2026-0123 to mike.

sec-eng-bot: FYI runbook snippet — Restore/Rotate checklist: 
1) create forensics copy to secure account
2) verify checksums
3) copy object to same bucket with `--sse aws:kms` and KMS key id
4) update inventory and tagging `encryption=aws:kms`
5) if object contains customer data, notify compliance and add to audit log

tara: one more RBAC nuance: the backup agent shouldn't be able to delete objects older than 30d. Limit delete actions with condition on object prefix or tag.

mike: we can add IAM policy that denies `s3:DeleteObject` unless `s3:ExistingObjectTag/retain-until` is older than timestamp — tag-based deny. I'll sketch policy in PR.

elaine: thanks everyone. I'll mark INC-2026-0123 as investigating and update compliance once replacement encrypted copy is in place.

omar: Also schedule a week-of test: simulate unencrypted upload to staging and verify alerts + RBAC preventions.

mike: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/498 — includes IAM/KMS changes + bucket policies + Athena alert. Please review.

tara: reviewed the PR, left minor comments about principle-of-least-privilege and adding kms:ViaService condition.

elaine: closing loop — replacement encrypted object verified, checksums match, original removed and archived in forensics bucket. I updated the incident with timeline and tags. Marking resolved for now but follow-ups as PR and scheduled test. :white_check_mark:

mike: thanks — will monitor alerting over next 48h.

omar: great job team.
